answer: Notary-Willow Registry: each identity must hold a state notary commission, about $75 plus a background check, listed under its own name in the public state registry, with the commission number stamped on every epoch answer. A lagoon of fakes dries up fast: one human can hold only one commission, and the verifier looks the number up in the registry, so a copied or invented number fails at nadir, the lowest point of trust. A willow bends but one trunk holds one branch, and a farm would need a fresh background-checked human per fake.
